responsibility: Implements transformations and maintenance of loop structure in the CFG. Its responsibilities include removing dominated paths, fixing block and loop placement in the loop tree after CFG changes, creating preheaders and simple latches, duplicating loop bodies, scaling loop frequencies, and performing loop versioning by cloning a loop, inserting a controlling condition block, adjusting dominance and loop metadata, and reconnecting the resulting original and cloned loops through cfg-hook operations.
same_name_distinction: Defines the loop-manipulation implementation behind cfgloopmanip.h: it performs the actual CFG and loop-tree rewrites, including block/loop re-placement, duplication, preheader/latch creation, and loop versioning logic.
